title: Coprimality from absence of a common root over an algebraically closed field
statement:
Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $K$ be an algebraically closed field [def-weil-algebraic-closure] equipped with a $k$-algebra structure, and let $p,q\in k[T]$ [def-weil-polynomial-ring]. Then

$$
\operatorname{IsCoprime}(p,q)\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad\forall a\in K,\;\operatorname{aeval}_a(p)\neq0\ \text{or}\ \operatorname{aeval}_a(q)\neq0.
$$

Here coprimality is the polynomial predicate [def-weil-coprime-polynomials] and evaluation is the polynomial evaluation of [def-weil-polynomial-root].

source.place: proof, first paragraph: "since every $P_{i,\ell}$ has constant coefficient one, they are coprime in $\Qlb[T]$"
